verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a published OpenAPI spec at docs.coderabbit.ai/openapi.json, so a documented API exists, but nothing in the pack describes its endpoints, authentication or scope. That leaves it unclear how much of the product (reviews, triage, configuration) an AI-native user can actually drive through it. Other programmatic surfaces, the official CLI and @coderabbitai comment commands, partially fill the gap but are not a public API. Missing for 10: first-party API reference content describing endpoints and auth, evidence that core review/triage workflows are API-drivable, independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.
